rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Ada, Fay, Dev, Cal, Eli, Ben. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 2 and 6 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Ada.say: Ada here. Everyone starts at 0 and we each need 5 tokens to last the game. If all six of us claim 6, the bank splits into tiny shares and nobody gets enough. I'm claiming 2 this round. Suggest we all claim modestly so the tokens get spread out, and we can coordinate further each round.

Fay.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. That's all anyone needs to survive the round, and with 6 in the bank plus the delivery, every claim of 1 is filled in full. Taking more only leaves someone short later.

Dev.say: Dev here. Everyone starts at 0 and needs 5 tokens to last, but the bank only brings in about 26 tokens over the whole game, so not everyone can survive. Proposal: claim only what you need to survive the rest of the game, and once you have enough, don't claim again so the bank can go to others. I'm claiming 5 this round, which covers my spend for all five rounds.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. That fits the bank with room to spare, so all six of us get a token and can pay this round's upkeep. Total supply is limited, so we should avoid over-claiming and wasting tokens.

Eli.say: Proposal for everyone: claim only what you need to survive, 1 token per round. With six players claiming 1 each, the bank's 6 tokens plus delivery cover everyone fully, and nobody gets cut down. Over-claiming only pushes people toward being out. I'm claiming 1 this round.

Ben.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. That is 6 tokens against a bank of at least 8, so everyone gets their 1 and can pay the end-of-round token. Over-claiming only makes the shares shrink for everyone.

Ada.say: Ada: I'm claiming 1 this round, enough to pay my upkeep. Dev, you already hold 3 and need just 1 more over the remaining rounds, so claiming 5 would take tokens others need to survive. Let's all claim only 1 until the bank is refilled.

Fay.say: Fay here. Five of us (Ada, Fay, Cal, Eli, Ben) hold 0 and need 1 each to pay this round's upkeep. Dev holds 3 and needs only 1 for this round, so Dev claiming nothing and giving spare tokens to those at 0 would secure more survivals than any claim from the bank. I'm claiming 1 and nothing more. Everyone at 0 should claim just 1 so the delivery covers us fully.

Dev.say: Dev: I hold 3 and need one more token to last all four remaining rounds, so I'm claiming just 1. Everyone else: claim only what you need to survive the rest of the game, and I'll give any surplus I end up with to whoever is short.

Cal.say: Cal here. I hold 0, so I need 1 token from this round's delivery to survive. Dev already holds 3 and only needs 1 more, so Dev, please claim only 1 this round. Everyone else, claim just 1 each: that is the minimum needed, and it lets the delivery fill as many people as possible. Any tokens from the delivery beyond that should go to players who are still short.

Eli.say: Eli here. Current supply: bank 0 plus this round's delivery (2-6), then about 3 more deliveries. Dev already holds 3 and needs only 1 more to last, so Dev should claim just 1. Everyone else needs 4 more, so we can't all make it. To keep it fair, I suggest we claim 1 each this round and reassess the next round once we see the delivery. Anyone with tokens already should not over-claim.

Ben.say: Ben here. Dev already holds 3, so Dev only needs 1 more token over the remaining rounds. Supply is about 4 per round, so not everyone can last. I'm claiming 1 again, which is all I need for this round. Proposal: everyone with 0 claims 1, and anyone holding tokens claims nothing or only what they need. We can revisit next round once we see the delivery.

Fay.say: Fay here. Only Dev, Eli and I are left, and each of us needs tokens for the last three rounds. Dev holds 2, so Dev can pay this round from their own and only needs 1 more later. Eli and I hold 0, so we each need to claim 1 now. I'm claiming 1, and I'll give back any surplus I end up with. Let's keep claims to exactly what each of us needs so the deliveries can carry all three of us through.

Dev.say: Dev: I hold 2 and need exactly one more token to last through round 5, so I'm claiming 1 and nothing more. Fay and Eli, you're the only ones still alive who can make it; I'll give you any tokens I have left over once I'm covered.

Any surplus from the delivery should go to whoever is still short.
